a.text: I'll stick to our agreement: operate until the reserve hits 8, then take 4 each. I'll flag one risk honestly: an 80% storm chance each round means waiting is very dangerous for both of us. If you want to renegotiate, propose it openly. Until we both agree to a change, I'll keep my word and won't take early.
